protocol.comparison_unit: One engine and one exact model profile, native versus Docker; identical model artifacts and configuration are required.
protocol.cross_engine_or_profile_results: Separate quality/throughput tradeoff; never container overhead or runtime parity.
protocol.cold_start: Each cold repetition starts a fresh process/model; already-loaded models do not qualify.
protocol.warm_cache: Optional separate series with at least 3 repetitions; report actual cached/reused tokens.
protocol.run_success_rate: accepted runs / all started runs; failures and timeouts count in the denominator.
protocol.attempt_acceptance_rate: accepted attempts / all started attempts; retries and failed attempts count in the denominator.
protocol.independent_acceptance: Preserve patch; test a copy of baseline with exact patch applied; inspect paths and obtain independent review.
protocol.privacy: Hashes and privacy-safe metadata only; exclude raw private prompts, private paths, secrets, tokens, credential-bearing URLs, and environment dumps.
protocol.launch_settings: Record full non-secret launch/request settings; omit credentials and reference credential sources privately.
protocol.service_lifecycle: Do not stop, restart, unload, or alter a shared service without explicit operator authorization.
protocol.resource_reporting: Timestamp samples and interval; separate snapshots and sampled peaks; label host, process/container, VM, and VRAM scopes. Unsupported values are null with reason.
protocol.claim_gate: No comparative claim with missing pins, unmatched artifacts/settings, insufficient repetitions, or missing acceptance evidence.
